title: Remote access
description: Reach your office from a laptop, phone, or CI runner.

sections.title: Local by default
paragraphs: A new office listens on 127.0.0.1:4000 and is only reachable from the server machine. Change the port with --port or the PORT environment variable.

sections.title: Tailscale
paragraphs: The simplest remote setup is Tailscale. tailscale serve keeps the office private to your tailnet; tailscale funnel makes it public, which inbound webhooks need. Then enter the https://…ts.net address as the public URL in User Settings → Access and restart Bureau.
sections.code:
tailscale serve --bg http://localhost:4000    # private to your tailnet
tailscale funnel --bg http://localhost:4000   # public

sections.title: Your own domain
paragraphs: Behind Caddy or another reverse proxy, set the public URL to your domain and set BUREAU_TRUSTED_PROXY to same-host or load-balancer so rate limits see real client addresses. Requests that arrive through a proxy always count as off the server machine, even when the proxy runs locally.
